title: Explicit Buchstab switching minorant
objective: Derive and independently test a pointwise Buchstab switching minorant for the original odd-factor rough-complement count, obtaining a justified positive coefficient or a precise checked failure certificate without substituting either for a Goldbach solution.
deliverables: One explicit switching minorant and coefficient formula
Independent finite identities and rigorous coefficient certificate
success_criteria: Every imported sieve theorem is applied within its actual parameter range
Least-factor endpoints, repeated factors and remaining factor 1 are preserved
A numerical scan is not labeled a uniform coefficient proof
A failed minorant is not generalized to every possible proof method
Goldbach remains unresolved unless the actual pointwise positivity is proved and independently reviewed
stop_conditions: One six-stage round within 20 dispatch proxy units
No separately billed provider or external mutable action
Preserve any nonpositive coefficient and choose a genuinely different next route if required
